names: UCSF Orthopaedic Institute at Mission Bay
summary: A UCSF Health outpatient medical building at 1500 Owens Street in Mission Bay South, housing the UCSF Orthopaedic Institute along with Radiology, Sports Medicine, and Physical Therapy & Rehabilitation clinics. The Orthopaedic Institute opened here October 1, 2009 -- the first UCSF clinical service to open at Mission Bay -- and DataSF's Assessor tax roll records the parcel's construction year as 2009.

open_questions: Architect and general contractor not confirmed by any source found in this pass.

Whether the other clinics now at this address (Sports Medicine, Physical Therapy & Rehabilitation, Gynecology & Urogynecology) opened at the same time as the Orthopaedic Institute or moved in later is not established.

The 2006 construction permit's own block/lot (block 8709, lot 006) differs from the lot the Assessor now uses for this address (lot 018); Mission Bay parcels were renumbered after this permit was filed, and the address, 6-story office/lab/retail description, and 2009 permit-completion date all line up with this parcel, so this is treated as a lot renumbering, not a different building.
